Game Overview

Furry Wedding Proposal is a animal game built around join a charming love story between a dashing fox and a graceful bunny on their journey to the perfect wedding. Unleash your creativity as their stylist, picking stunning outfits, chic hairstyles, and elegant makeup. Craft a fairy tale experience, making this unique couple's dream day unforgettable!
